effect_colorloop.description: Runs an effect with looping colors.

brightness.description: Number indicating brightness of the color loop, where 1 is the minimum brightness and 255 is the maximum brightness supported by the light.
brightness.name: Brightness value

brightness_pct.description: Percentage indicating the brightness of the color loop, where 1 is the minimum brightness and 100 is the maximum brightness supported by the light.
brightness_pct.name: Brightness

change.description: Hue movement per period, in degrees on a color wheel.
change.name: Change

saturation_max.description: Percentage indicating the maximum saturation of the colors in the loop.
saturation_max.name: Maximum saturation

saturation_min.description: Percentage indicating the minimum saturation of the colors in the loop.
saturation_min.name: Minimum saturation

spread.description: Maximum hue difference between participating lights, in degrees on a color wheel.
spread.name: Spread

transition.description: Duration of the transition between colors.
transition.name: Transition

effect_colorloop.name: Color loop effect

effect_colorsweep.description: Starts a firmware-based effect on LIFX Mirror lights that sweeps through a palette of colors, by default the color temperature range.

duration.description: How long the effect runs. 0 runs it until it is stopped.
duration.name: Duration

palette.description: List of at least 2 and at most 16 colors as hue (0-360), saturation (0-100), brightness (0-100) and Kelvin (1500-9000) values to sweep through. Defaults to sweeping from 1500 to 6500 Kelvin.
palette.name: Palette

speed.description: How long one sweep takes. 0 sweeps once across the duration, which then has to be set.
speed.name: Speed

effect_colorsweep.name: Color sweep effect

effect_flame.description: Starts the firmware-based Flame effect on LIFX Tiles or Candle.

speed.description: How fast the flames will move.
speed.name: Speed

effect_flame.name: Flame effect

effect_morph.description: Starts the firmware-based Morph effect on LIFX Tiles or Candle.

palette.description: List of at least 2 and at most 16 colors as hue (0-360), saturation (0-100), brightness (0-100) and Kelvin (1500-9000) values to use for this effect. Overrides the 'Theme' attribute.
palette.name: Palette

speed.description: How fast the colors will move.
speed.name: Speed

theme.description: Predefined color theme to use for the effect. Overridden by the 'Palette' attribute.
theme.name: [%key:component::lifx::entity::select::theme::name%]

effect_morph.name: Morph effect

effect_move.description: Starts the firmware-based Move effect on a LIFX Z, Lightstrip or Beam.

direction.description: Direction the effect will move across the device.
direction.name: Direction

power_on.description: Powered off lights will be turned on before starting the effect.
power_on.name: Power on

speed.description: How long in seconds for the effect to move across the length of the light.
speed.name: Speed

theme.description: (Optional) set one of the predefined themes onto the device before starting the effect.
theme.name: [%key:component::lifx::entity::select::theme::name%]

effect_move.name: Move effect

effect_pulse.description: Runs a flash effect by changing to a color and back.

brightness.description: Number indicating brightness of the temporary color, where 1 is the minimum brightness and 255 is the maximum brightness supported by the light.
brightness.name: Brightness value

brightness_pct.description: Percentage indicating the brightness of the temporary color, where 1 is the minimum brightness and 100 is the maximum brightness supported by the light.
brightness_pct.name: Brightness

color_temp_kelvin.description: The temporary color temperature in Kelvin.
color_temp_kelvin.name: [%key:component::light::common::field_color_temp_kelvin_name%]

cycles.description: Number of times the effect should run.
cycles.name: Cycles

hs_color.description: The temporary color in hue/sat format. A list of two numbers. Hue is 0-360 and Sat is 0-100.
hs_color.name: [%key:component::light::common::field_hs_color_name%]

power_on.description: Powered off lights are temporarily turned on during the effect.
power_on.name: Power on

xy_color.description: The temporary color in XY-format. A list of two decimal numbers between 0 and 1.
xy_color.name: [%key:component::light::common::field_xy_color_name%]

effect_pulse.name: Pulse effect

effect_sky.description: Starts a firmware-based effect on LIFX Ceiling lights that animates a sky scene across the device.

cloud_saturation_max.description: The maximum cloud saturation for the Clouds sky type.
cloud_saturation_max.name: Cloud saturation maximum

cloud_saturation_min.description: The minimum cloud saturation for the Clouds sky type.
cloud_saturation_min.name: Cloud saturation minimum

duration.description: How long the effect runs. 0 runs it until it is stopped.
duration.name: Duration

palette.description: List of 1 to 6 colors as hue (0-360), saturation (0-100), brightness (0-100) and Kelvin (1500-9000) values to use for this effect.
palette.name: Palette

sky_type.description: The style of sky that will be animated by the effect.
sky_type.name: Sky type

speed.description: How long the Sunrise and Sunset sky types will take to complete. For the Clouds sky type, it is the speed of the clouds across the device. 0 plays the effect once across the duration, which then has to be set.
speed.name: Speed

effect_sky.name: Sky effect

paint_theme.description: Paints either a provided theme or custom palette across one or more LIFX lights.

palette.description: List of at least 2 and at most 16 colors as hue (0-360), saturation (0-100), brightness (0-100) and Kelvin (1500-9000) values to paint across the target lights. Overrides the 'Theme' attribute.
palette.name: Palette

power_on.description: Powered off lights will be turned on before painting the theme.
power_on.name: Power on

theme.description: Predefined color theme to paint. Overridden by the 'Palette' attribute.
theme.name: [%key:component::lifx::entity::select::theme::name%]

transition.description: Duration in seconds to paint the theme.
transition.name: Transition

paint_theme.name: Paint theme

duration.description: How long the HEV LEDs will remain on. Uses the configured default duration if not specified.

power.description: Start or stop a Clean cycle.
power.name: [%key:common::action::enable%]

set_hev_cycle_state.name: Set HEV cycle state

set_mood.description: Sets the mood on one or more LIFX lights by applying a Mood the way the LIFX app does. Each light keeps its current brightness.
set_mood.name: Set mood

set_state.description: Sets a color/brightness and possibly turn the light on/off.

infrared.description: Automatic infrared level when light brightness is low.
infrared.name: Infrared

power.description: Turn the light on or off. Leave out to keep the power as it is.
power.name: Power

transition.description: Duration it takes to get to the final state.
transition.name: Transition

zones.description: List of zone numbers to affect (8 per LIFX Z, starts at 0).
zones.name: Zones

set_state.name: Set state
